spec.name: Zaouïa Mjoueliya
spec.description: Zaouïa Mjoueliya is a historic religious and spiritual institution in Ksar el-Kebir, established during the 17th and 18th centuries. As part of the city's rich Sufi heritage, it traditionally served as a center for prayer, Quranic education, and a sanctuary for travelers and the needy, contributing to the city's reputation as a land of saints and scholars.

timeline.title: Establishment
timeline.description: Emergence of the Zaouïa Mjoueliya as a spiritual center in Ksar el-Kebir.
